steps.why: The repo's setup copies settings.py.example to settings.py, and modules import settings at load time, so tests need it to exist (-n keeps any existing file).
pyproject.toml addopts pass --cov flags, which pytest rejects unless the pytest-cov plugin is installed.
The README setup copies settings.py.example to settings.py, and the code likely imports it at load time.

exclusion.reason: pytest reports 28 setup errors in tests/unit (apprise_sender, gpt, helpers, scheduled_image); the cause isn't shown, but nothing points to credentials, private deps or an unrunnable toolchain, so it is treated as the repo's own test/fixture failures.
